name: Proposal for a decision
title: REPORT on discharge in respect of the implementation of the general budget of the European Union for the financial year 2024, Section X – European External Action Service
part_text:
The European Parliament approves how the European External Action Service (the European Union's diplomatic service) spent its 2024 budget, which was about 880 million euros plus money from the European Commission. It also lists what it wants improved: fewer late payments, better security for staff and buildings, more women in senior jobs, fairer hiring across countries, stronger action against Russian disinformation, and answers about a fraud investigation into the European Union Diplomatic Academy. The report is mostly recommendations, not new law.

- **What changes:** Nothing in law. Parliament signs off the 2024 spending and asks for fixes.
- **Who it affects:** The European External Action Service, its 145 delegations worldwide, and its staff.
- **What happens next:** The service must report back on late payments, security, hiring and the fraud case.
